name: Spectrum of Hybrids
source:
Say you had the chance to do anything you wanted, anything at all — be a hybrid and connect with another hybrid?  Get your dream job or retire, possibly dabble in magic?

However, what if that came at a cost?  What if, in order to make that reality your reality, you had to chip away at who and what you were?  Would it still be worth it?

This is the question posed to you in Spectrum of Hybrids.  Take control of one of five potential main characters, and experience their own personal story of self-discovery, interwoven into a greater plot about a world of hidden magic and large creatures!  Compatible characters can be "mix and matched" for dozens of routes and perspectives.

[From [url=https://tehguthroth.itch.io/spectrum-of-hybrids]Itch.io[/url]]
